ReviewResult

VERDICT: FAIL

Findings:

HIGH — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/actions.ts.tmpl:46` / `page.tsx.tmpl:135`
The server action contract does not match the rendered form. The action requires `ownerClass` and `nextChecked`, but both forms submit `id` and `checked` only (`page.tsx.tmpl:135-136`, `179-180`). Result: every normal toggle is rejected at `actions.ts.tmpl:47` before `patchChecklistItem()` or `revalidatePath()` can run.

HIGH — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/actions.ts.tmpl:46`
The owner-action-only restriction is enforced from client-controlled `FormData`. A founder can submit `ownerClass=owner-action` for any id; the server does not derive toggleability from the current readiness report/checklist before writing at `actions.ts.tmpl:56`. This is a backend input-handling seam failure.

HIGH — `scripts/checks/brand-leak-scan.js:102`
`brand-leak-scan` is not fail-closed. Missing/unreadable scan roots produce an empty `surfaces` list, unreadable files are skipped at `113-114`, and success is `errors.length === 0` at `134`. Confirmed behavior: `--scaffold-dir` pointing at a missing dir returns `{ ok: true, scanned: 0 }`.

MEDIUM — `scripts/checks/scaffold-coverage-scan.js:367`
Readiness scaffold completeness is under-enforced. The panel files list requires only `page.tsx.tmpl` and `actions.ts.tmpl`, while `src/lib/readiness` only needs “at least one” `.ts.tmpl` at `393-405`. Missing `writeback.ts.tmpl`, `group.ts.tmpl`, or `types.ts.tmpl` can slip through despite the page/action imports requiring them.

MEDIUM — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/lib/readiness/writeback.ts.tmpl:65`
The byte-preservation contract is not exact. `raw.split(/\r?\n/)` plus a single newline choice based on `raw.includes("\r\n")` normalizes mixed line endings when rejoining at `97`, changing non-target bytes.

MEDIUM — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/lib/readiness/writeback.ts.tmpl:102`
Tmp cleanup is only best-effort, not guaranteed. On write/rename failure the code tries `unlinkSync(tmpPath)` but swallows cleanup failure at `108-111`, despite the contract saying failed patches leave no tmp behind.

Confirmed non-findings: `ID_TOKEN` is anchored to the checklist marker position and compares the captured id exactly, so a later label `id=` token is not matched. The direct producer-to-view strip is present in `toReadinessView()` (`group.ts.tmpl:21-36`) and removes `schema`, `product_id`, and item `source` before rendering.
